text: The semantic model is verified. Now we build what the VP of Operations actually opens every morning: a single-page dashboard rolling up all fourteen stores at once, with the ability to drill into any one store without leaving the page.

The layout follows her stated routine exactly: KPI cards up top, a fourteen-store matrix as the centerpiece sorted by net sales, a trend line and category breakdown below, and a hidden Store Detail page reachable only through drill-through.
Conditional formatting flags the year-over-year card red the moment it goes negative -- a built-in rule, not a manually colored text box, so it updates itself as the data changes.
Drill-through needs one field in the Drillthrough well on a hidden page: right-click any store's row in the matrix, and the VP gets a single-store deep dive without a second report.
The implementation phase is done. Next, we stop building and start proving every number actually holds up.
